sections.title: Add from the left
facts: Tens first, then ones, then join: $47 + 38 = 70 + 15 = 85$.
If the ones make $10$ or more, the extra ten joins the tens: $70 + 15 = 85$.

sections.title: Bigger numbers
facts: Keep a running total in your head: $400$, $460$, $467$.

sections.title: Subtract from the left
facts: When every digit on top is bigger: $86 - 34 = 50 + 2 = 52$.

sections.title: Two jumps back
facts: Jump back the tens, then the ones: $72 - 38 = 72 - 30 - 8 = 34$.
Cross a ten on the second jump by going back to the ten first: $42 - 8 = 42 - 2 - 6 = 34$.
